info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Fitness Memberships Create-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Creation API facilitates the onboarding of new members into a fitness program efficiently. This endpoint allows businesses to manage bulk memberships, enabling them to streamline their customer acquisition efforts. Typical consumers of this API include fitness centers and gyms looking to enhance their membership processes. By using this API, organizations can ensure a seamless and user-friendly experience for potential members, thereby boosting their membership growth.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new membership entry in the system. You will need to provide the necessary details for the membership, such as the member's information and any associated plans.
